content:
Anne Hathaway is officially a mom of three after starring in five major movies this year.

The actor, 44, has welcomed her third child with husband Adam Shulman, multiple outlets confirmed on Tuesday.

TMZ shared photos of Hathaway walking around New York City on Tuesday with her little bundle of joy strapped to her chest in a carrier.

Hathaway and Shulman have been married since 2012, and also share sons Jonathan and Jack. They have not publicly announced the gender of their third baby or the date the child was born.

Hathaway’s representatives did not immediately respond to HuffPost’s request for comment.

In a clip set to the song “Baby I’m Yours” by Barbara Lewis, Hathaway stepped into the camera wearing a white flowy skirt and cropped blouse that offered a peek at her belly. She captioned the post: “x Baby, I’m yours x.”

The star got candid about how motherhood has impacted her life in a 2022 interview with WSJ Magazine.

“I didn’t feel fully landed and fully here until I was a mom,” she told the publication. “It’s not like I was lacking integrity, but it made me want to be completely, on every level, true to my word.”

Hathaway added: “And that meant stopping any nonsense that I had going on inside myself. And it’s little breaks that you give yourself sometimes when you know that you’re not being your best self.”
